task: FV2-030 — Flutter protected image thumbnail failure fallback parity
summary: Flutter now matches the web card fallback when an authenticated image thumbnail request fails or the returned bytes cannot be decoded. The fallback is a compact 340×62 file card with a 44×44 open-preview icon; opening the protected viewer and the separate download action remain available.

checks.name: Test-first baseline reproduction
checks.command: cd clients/flutter && flutter test --no-pub test/message_attachment_list_test.dart --plain-name 'uses the web file-card fallback when thumbnail loading fails'
checks.observation: The regression expected the web file card at 340×62 but the existing Flutter UI rendered the failed image card at 440×238.

checks.name: Focused attachment viewer and card suite
checks.observation: Covers 404 thumbnail fallback with click-through to the protected viewer, invalid-image decode fallback, successful image geometry, generic file-card geometry, viewer retry and accessibility behavior.

checks.name: Android Debug build
checks.observation: Built only; APK was not installed on the emulator.

checks.name: macOS Debug build
checks.observation: Built without launching or restarting the signed-in application.

checks.name: macOS live-session preservation
checks.observation: Accessibility and screenshot inspection confirmed the existing signed-in Mac app remained on the same TEXT channel with its previously loaded protected image. No message, attachment, or account state was mutated. The live endpoint returned a valid preview, so this session did not visually exercise the failure branch.

checks.name: Android runtime failure-state visual acceptance
checks.observation: The Android Debug APK was built but not installed; no backend attachment was altered to manufacture a failure state.

checks.name: Spec traceability verifier
checks.observation: PowerShell Core is not installed on this host.

limitations: The web-matching error and decode paths are covered by widget regressions, but the failure branch was not forced against the live backend on a device.
Windows runtime visual acceptance is unavailable on this macOS host and remains tracked by FV2-006.
